system.description: You jump up to 4 feet (1 m) into the air and make a melee attack against a foe on the way up or down. If you hit, you inflict damage and can attempt a difficulty 4 Might roll to inflict an additional 4 damage and knock them prone. Effort: Add 2 feet to the jump height and an additional 2 damage to the attack (whether or not you knock the target prone). Action.
